howToPlay: Use Stu's fast movement to get close to enemies or dodge incoming attacks. Hit opponents with basic attacks to charge the Nitro Boost Super and keep mobility high. Use the Speed Zone gadget to support the team or the Breakthrough gadget to create new paths through obstacles.
gears: Equip Damage to boost output when low on health, or choose Shield for extra durability. Speed is excellent for navigating maps with bushes, while Gadget Cooldown is highly effective for using speed and wall-breaking tools more often.
trait: This assassin suits players who excel at high-speed tactical movement and rapid ability chaining.
